_comment: The ship's parts (wear and upgrades decision 5): the one source. Tools/setup_ship_parts.py authors Content/Ship/Parts from it; DeepSpace.Ship.Parts.Contract holds the assets and FShipRatings::Stock() to it; DeepSpace.Ship.Parts.CatalogueRules holds decision 7 over it. Ratings are in engine units (LinearAcceleration in cm/s^2). A rating a row leaves out reads stock. Names and words are placeholders (sign-off 12): character and history, never quality.

parts.name: Fusion bottle
parts.words: Hums in the deck plates. Nobody aboard remembers it new.

parts.name: Twin-core reactor
parts.words: Hums a fifth low. Came off a salvage tug.

parts.name: Fold drive
parts.words: Ticks for a minute after every fold.

parts.name: Quick-lever drive
parts.words: Takes the lever before you have let go of it.

parts.name: Booster cluster
parts.words: Quiet until you lean on them.

parts.name: Interior lighting
parts.words: Warm, a little amber in the corridor.

parts.name: Air plant
parts.words: Somebody taped the filter door shut.

parts.name: Survey array
parts.words: Older than the hull, and it shows.
